newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Valentine stamp offers whiff of romance.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Valentine stamp offers whiff of romance.

text.p: Dutch lovers aiming for that extra romantic touch on February 14 will be able to say it with the stamp they stick on their Valentine cards.
The Dutch post office said on Tuesday it was launching stamps with special heart-shaped "scratch" panels which, when rubbed away, reveal slogans declaring love, longing or just a row of kisses.

As an extra treat the stamps release a rose scent once scratched. However, in an emphatically unromantic post office marketing move, lovers only get to choose their slogan if they buy a strip of ten stamps.
